title: Drupal warns of active exploitation of CVE-2026-136716 installer flaw
content_md:
Drupal warns that CVE-2026-136716 is being actively exploited in the Drupal installer.

Article link: https://guiadeti.com.br/noticias/drupal-alerta-exploracao-falha-instalador/
exclude_reason: Duplicate social coverage of the already documented active exploitation of Drupal CVE-2026-136716; adds no new development.
